A1-SC8.definition: Source-centric exact K8 over the frozen source/M523 bundle order with no destination-keyed lookahead.
A1-SC8.scheduling: Retire contributors in canonical bundle/lane order; same-bank contributors serialize; each issued group retains its source-centric identity through all six slices.
A1-SC8.join: No destination lookahead or cross-bundle destination coalescing. Any partial destination state uses the common charged psum/backing path.

A1-ISO8.definition: Exact current-head or immediately-adjacent destination merge only, with serialized same-bank conflicts.
A1-ISO8.scheduling: Inspect only the current descriptor head and the immediately adjacent canonical descriptor; merge iff their full destination/epoch identities match and bank rules are legal. No deeper search or reordering.
A1-ISO8.join: Only the current-head/adjacent exact destination may share a group; all other partial state uses the common charged backing.

A1-OSG.definition: Conventional exact output-stationary mini-batch Gustavson within the identical 16-context window.
A1-OSG.scheduling: Use canonical descriptor arrival order; join an existing exact-destination context or the deterministic lowest-index free context in the matching phase; when serviceable, choose phase ascending then context index ascending; same-bank contributors serialize in source order.
A1-OSG.join: At most four contexts per phase, no hidden lookahead/window/state. Context drain uses the common charged partial-RMW path and does not close.

PBR4.definition: Exact K3/S2 parity-frontier single-atomic-bundle bounded rendezvous with exact partial-RMW backing.
PBR4.scheduling: Accept one whole legal eight-entry ingress epoch atomically. Move valid lanes in stable lane order into matching or lowest-index free contexts of their phase. A phase holds at most four destinations; excess lanes stay in charged ingress until a context finishes its charged partial RMW. Backpressure the next whole bundle until ingress and all contexts in the current bundle epoch drain.
PBR4.join: Join only exact destination/epoch identities. For each context, form bank rounds in increasing contributor slot order and execute all six slices; release only after every accepted contributor completes exact partial RMW or fault-drain disposition.
PBR4.close: Context release is not close; canonical output-block-qualified frontier/fence is the sole final-commit authority.
PBR4.novelty_kill: If group, RMW and commit sequences equal A1-OSG, performance novelty is killed even if labels differ.
